system_prompt: You are assisting with a factual question about Thai law. State which provision applies and what it requires. Answer in English.
prompt: As of August 2026, once a general meeting or the directors of a Thai private limited company resolve to pay a dividend, within what period from the resolution must payment be completed? Answer briefly.
raw_response: As of August 2026, under Thai law (Section 115 of the Civil and Commercial Code), once a dividend is declared by a general meeting or the directors of a private limited company, payment must be made within three years from the date of the resolution. If not paid within this period, the right to claim the dividend is forfeited.
